thread:
sanjay: uploaded the latest A100 vs H100 bench CSV to /perf/artifacts/420123 — prefills+decode across mistral-7b and llama-7b variants. quick summary in next msg.

maya: thanks — saw the file. quick highlights: H100 p50 decode 14–20% faster on us-east1, p95 gap smaller when KV cache hit > 80%. A100 wins on $/1M tokens for q8x4 in eu-west1 due to cheaper spot pricing.

sanjay: exact numbers from one run (mistral-7b, seq=1024, mix q8x4 vs q4f16):
```
region   | gpu  | tokens/sec (p50) | p95 latency(ms) | $/1M tokens
us-east1 | H100 | 3200             | 240              | $42
us-east1 | A100 | 2700             | 280              | $36
eu-west1 | H100 | 3000             | 260              | $48
eu-west1 | A100 | 2550             | 300              | $33
```

leo: interesting that p95 delta shrinks with higher KV hit. did you run a coldstart slice?

sanjay: yes — coldstart (kv=0) shows H100 p95 decode ~35% better. warm (kv>70%) gap drops to ~8%. suggests kernel path favors long-lived KV cache on H100.

elly: any quality regressions with q8x4? our eval suite (mix-prompts, factuality) flagged tiny perf drift on Llama prompts. numbers?
maya: ran a small eval set of 1k prompts — q8x4 vs fp16 on mistral: EM drop ~0.6%, avg perplexity +0.4. not huge but noticeable on some prompt families (system-instructions).

sanjay: timeline: want to ship q8x4 as default on Dedicated for eu-west1 because cost, but gate by quality alert thresholds. thoughts on fallback policy?

leo: suggestion: routing policy that prefers A100:q8x4 when cost target hit, but for routes with high quality sensitivity route to H100:fp16. config snippet:
```yaml
route: /chat/*
policy:
  - if route_label == "sensitive": prefer: [h100_fp16]
  - else: prefer: [a100_q8x4, h100_fp16]
```

sanjay: perfect. also noticed kernel mismatch in eu-west1: our runtime fell back to generic attention kernel on H100 for q8x4 under seq>2048, causing throughput step-down. created GH issue #1247.

infra-bot: artifact uploaded -> s3://redwood-perf/420123/results.csv ; bench job id 420123-09 ; tags: [mistral-7b,q8x4,a100,h100,eu-west1].

maya: next steps: (1) reproduce on fresh infra with deterministic seeds, (2) run extended eval (10k prompts) focused on instruction prompts, (3) instrument kernel selection telemetry to catch the fallback. I'll own 1+2, leo picks 3. 

sanjay: thanks — I'll draft an ops note for Dedicated pricing guidance (H100 perf vs A100 cost trade-offs). 

elly: quick ask — can we add $/1M tokens columns normalized to committed price (not spot) so sales has a clean number?
sanjay: yes will add committed-price view to the CSV and post update by EOD. :thumbsup:
